title: Tensor CUR Decomposition under the Linear-Map-Based Tensor-Tensor Multiplication
summary: The factorization of three-dimensional data continues to gain attention due to its relevance in representing and compressing large-scale datasets. The linear-map-based tensor-tensor multiplication is a matrix-mimetic operation that extends the notion of matrix multiplication to higher order tensors, and which is a generalization of the T-product.
